rows.alignment_note: markers, pen timestamps are on server_wall_clock, not the 'watch_capture_clock' clock the primary motion stream uses (see channels.parquet's time_domain column for the per-modality declaration). The offset between the clocks is estimated but not applied or published: pen_delta_s is left NaN by design (publishing an estimated delta risks irreparable mislabeling); pen_delta_sigma is only the estimate's confidence, not the offset itself.
